$comment: Beginner layer: the 'At a glance' strip on compound pages, the fact sheet and the technical-details block (the TL;DR and the chapter list: common.tldr, common.chapters). Answers are keyed by data values (vocab.ts), so every compound with the same facts gets the same words. The approved answer is built from the whole sentences in glance.approved (src/lib/approval.ts): {list} is the locale's own jurisdictions (vocab.jurisdictionInSentence, joined with and / or), never a jurisdiction the locale does not cover. Keep every answer to one plain line (B1, everyday words, no jargon); short answers at most 4 words. Dutch: the locale's jurisdictions are NL and EU, so {list} is 'Nederland en de hele EU' / 'Nederland of de hele EU' (vocab.json explains 'de hele EU'); every {list} stands after a preposition, so the verb never has to agree with it.
